ideas.pitch: An ingredient substitution web app driven by FlavorDB molecule compound overlap and RecipeDB compatibility scores.
ideas.problem_statement: Innovate with Flavor and Data using RecipeDB and FlavorDB APIs to build ingredient substitution engines.
ideas.title: FlavorGraph AI: Dynamic Molecular Substitution Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the unique CoSy Lab datasets directly by combining compound-level flavor science with practical culinary substitutions, hitting the exact theme of computational gastronomy.

ideas.pitch: A custom cocktail recommendation system utilizing CocktailDB to suggest drinks matched to user dietary needs and flavor preferences.
ideas.problem_statement: Innovate with Flavor and Data using CocktailDB to build drink-pairing tools with nutritional data and dietary filters.
ideas.title: NutriSafe Cocktail AI & Molecular Pairing
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly taps into the specialized CocktailDB API, ensuring differentiation from the standard food recipe apps while factoring in strict nutritional constraints.

ideas.pitch: A recipe recommendation system that scales ingredients based on minimizing carbon footprint and maximizing flavor complementarity.
ideas.problem_statement: Innovate with Flavor and Data using RecipeDB and FlavorDB to build diet-aware systems and personalized recipe recommenders.
ideas.title: EcoChef: Carbon and Calorie Optimized Recipe Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Merges sustainability metrics with CoSy Lab's recipe data, proving concrete optimization metrics which appeal heavily to research-focused judges at IIIT Delhi.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven web application that suggests bizarre or avant-garde ingredient pairings based on shared flavor compounds from FlavorDB.
ideas.problem_statement: Innovate with Flavor and Data using FlavorDB to build AI-driven flavor-pairing applications.
ideas.title: AromaMatch: Automated Flavor-Pairing Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on complex data visualization of flavor compounds, showing off the algorithmic depth expected by CoSy Lab researchers.

ideas.pitch: A mobile-first web app taking medical dietary constraints and restructuring existing RecipeDB dishes into safe, flavorful alternatives.
ideas.problem_statement: Innovate with Flavor and Data using RecipeDB to build diet-aware systems.
ideas.title: HealPlate: Therapeutic Diet-Aware Recipe Restructurer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies computational gastronomy to solve a real-world health problem, giving it strong social impact and practical utility.
